links.outcome: LLM T/N staging accuracy versus existing manual registry entries
links.effect: Gemini 1.5 T- and N-stage accuracy 0.994 and 0.993; Qwen2.5 72B 0.971 and 0.923; both outperformed manual entries, which had error rates of 5.5-17.0%.
links.quote: Both a cloud-based LLM (Gemini 1.5; T- and N-stage accuracy: 0.994 and 0.993, respectively) and the top-performing local model (Qwen2.5 72B; T- and N-stage accuracy: 0.971 and 0.923, respectively) outperformed existing manual entries in extracting pathological T and N classifications.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to audit and correct manual cancer registry data entry
Comparing cloud-based versus local LLMs on unprocessed, non-anonymized reports

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the performance of off-the-shelf LLMs using prompt engineering to extract TNM staging from real-world gynecologic oncology reports compared against manual registry entry, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
